title: Java Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Java Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Work with software development teams to gather requirements and ensure best practices are adhered.

- Design, Implement & Support solutions for application development, security, analytics and performance management.

- Conform to existing industry security coding standards adhering to fortify scan and other security tool review requirements.

- Conduct code reviews for junior members of the team and do peer code reviews to make sure code is following standards set forward by the architects.

- Run test scripts against code to ensure quality delivery.

- Resolve code issues with urgency.


Requirements:


- 5+ years of experience in Java.

- Experience in web application programming.

- Knowledge of Object Oriented Programming.

- Ability to work with relational and non-relational bases.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Arquiteto de Software em Cloud
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Projetar serviços utilizando a infraestrutura em cloud da AWS e Terraform;
  • Atuar no desenvolvimento backend de uma solução web, utilizando Node.JS e Typescript;
  • Construir testes automatizados das soluções desenvolvidas com base em ferramentas existentes.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Formação superior em Engenharia/Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou similar;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento backend em Node.JS, typescript e frameworks (NESTJS);
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento frontend em React;
  • Experiência na construção e implantação de arquiteturas baseadas em micros serviços;
  • Experiência em conteinerização (Docker) e ferramentas de orquestração (Kubernetes);
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de monitoramente;
  • Experiência na criação de serviços e infraestrutura em cloud utilizando AWS;
  • Experiência no uso da ferramenta TerraForm;
  • Experiência com CI/CD com Jenkins; Git; etc.;
  • Inglês avançado para conversação, leitura e escrita.

title: Desenvolvedor Drupal
description:
Mandatory Requirements:


  • Fluent in English with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proven experience with Drupal 9/10/11 or readiness to transition to 11.
  • Strong proficiency in PHP , Twig , HTML5 , CSS3 , and JavaScript .
  • Experience with Drupal core/contrib upgrades and major version migrations.
  • Solid understanding and hands-on experience with the Migrate API , Feeds , or other migration tools.
  • Familiarity with Drupal theming, custom module development, and site building.
  • Experience with Composer , Drush , and Git .
  • Strong knowledge of database management, particularly MySQL .
  • Ability to work with legacy systems and migrate them into a modern CMS framework.


Desirable Requirements:


  • Experience in automated testing frameworks for Drupal .
  • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies.
  • Understanding of REST API integration.
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure .
  • Knowledge of additional CMS platforms for broader technological insights.


Summary of Requirements: Drupal 9/10/11, PHP, Twig, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Migrate API, Feeds, Composer, Drush, Git, MySQL, REST API, AWS, Azure.

title: Recruiter I
description:
Somos fanáticos por nossas pessoas! E demonstramos isso oferecendo uma cultura de pertencimento; caminhos claros para o desenvolvimento de carreira; programas de apoio profissional, coaching e mentoria, uma rede global de amigos e colegas que podem te suportar e mais! (Tipo, muito mais.).


Quer estar em uma multinacional que é Great Place to Work, apoiar as melhores marcas do mercado, inovar e mudar o mundo – tudo ao mesmo tempo em que estabelece conexões reais com as pessoas e desenvolve sua carreira?


Seja um #gamechanger Junte-se ao nosso time e vamos tornar isso oficial!

Todas as vagas da Concentrix vagas são elegíveis a Pessoas com Deficiência.


Estamos procurando por um(a) Recruiter I.


O que você fará:


• Responsável por auxiliar na implementação e administração de programas de recrutamento.

• Receber, selecionar e arquivar currículos.

• Conduzir entrevistas de triagem inicial, entrevistas por telefone e/ou entrevistas presenciais com candidatos em potencial.

• Seguir com as ofertas da vaga de acordo com a descrição da conta.

• Acompanhar o candidato desde o processo seletivo até a data de início na empresa.

• Utilizar diversos recursos - internet, organizações comunitárias, mídia impressa, redes formais/informais, faculdades, associações comerciais - para buscar candidatos qualificados, direta e indiretamente.

• Manter padrões consistentes para todos os candidatos e garantir a conformidade com todas as regras e regulamentos locais relacionados à contratação e recrutamento.

• Responsável por desenvolver e aplicar um conhecimento profundo das especificações do cargo, incluindo experiência, habilidades e competências comportamentais necessárias para o sucesso em cada função.

• Promover a imagem da empresa para candidatos e prestadores de serviços externos e garantir que a Empresa é representada da forma mais precisa e apropriada para todos os candidatos e impulsiona pessoalmente os mais altos padrões de comportamento ético para todos os envolvidos nos processos de recrutamento.


Se você possui:


• Um ano de experiência relevante com volumetria;

• Ensino superior cursando ou completo (Administração, Psicologia ou Gestão de Recursos Humanos);

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, tanto escrita quanto verbal;

• Capacidade de realizar múltiplas tarefas, priorizar e cumprir prazos de entrega;

• Proficiência em Microsoft Office;

• Autoiniciativa, senso de urgência, trabalha bem sob pressão, capacidade de trabalhar em ambientes de alta velocidade;

• Senso de profissionalismo e capacidade de desenvolver relacionamentos;

• Grande atenção aos detalhes;

• Capacidade de lidar e manter informações confidenciais.


Aqui é o seu lugar!


O que oferecemos:


• Oportunidade de carreira e desenvolvimento;

• Seguro de vida;

• Plano de Saúde

• Vale-Refeição e/ou Vale-alimentação;

• Vale-transporte;

• Auxílio creche;

• Plataforma online com diversos cursos disponíveis;

• Parceria com diversas Universidades e Escolas de idiomas.


Local de trabalho: Centro - Curitiba

Horário de trabalho: Seg à Sex das 08h00 às 17:48.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Your role and responsabilities:


  • Handling major incidents via CIRS (Critical Issue Response System) and providing frequent updates until resolution.
  • Performing deep-dive application troubleshooting and identifying preventive actions.
  • Managing CIRS-related requests including deployments, feature toggles, and data fixes.
  • Following up on major production incidents and coordinating with cross-functional teams.
  • Enhancing monitoring capabilities using tools like Dynatrace, Kibana, and Splunk .
  • Writing and improving monitoring scripts and alerts based on incident learnings.
  • Handling customer escalations and coordinating with Support & Engineering teams.
  • Supporting planned activities and responding to ad-hoc requests from CES teams.


Requirements and Qualifications:


  • Deep experience in DevOps and Production Support .
  • Experience in automation and CI/CD practices.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or Azure preferred).
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring tools such as Dynatrace, Kibana, Splunk .
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and ability to deep dive into application issues.
  • Excellent communication and coordination skills across teams.


Please submit resumé in English.

description:
APENAS APLIQUE SE VOCÊ TEM EXPERIÊNCIA COMO CLOSER HIGH TICKET E HISTÓRICO DE METAS BATIDAS


Sobre a HarmonizaPRO:

Somos a maior aceleradora comercial especializada em clínicas de harmonização facial do Brasil. 5 anos de mercado, 400+ clínicas atendidas, 35 pessoas no time, R$90k+/mês em tráfego pago gerando leads qualificados todos os dias.

Nosso trabalho: transformar clínicas em empresas lucrativas com método próprio, vendendo contratos de R$10k a R$78k.

Não somos uma empresa para todo mundo. Temos uma cultura de resultados. Quem performa, cresce rápido e ganha bem. Quem não performa, não fica.

Nosso time comercial é enxuto e de alta performance. Você vai trabalhar ao lado de pessoas que também têm \"sangue no olho\" e entregam acima da média. A régua é alta porque é assim que mantemos a qualidade.



O que você vai fazer:

Conduzir reuniões de vendas consultivas (média 4-6 calls/dia)

Fechar contratos de R$10k a R$60k

Gerir seu pipeline no Pipedrive com disciplina

Nutrir leads com follow-ups estratégicos

Participar das rotinas do time (daily, weekly, 1:1)


O que buscamos:

Experiência comprovada como closer (com resultados para mostrar)

Comunicação consultiva

Disciplina de processo e CRM

Proatividade e capacidade de resolver problemas sem precisar de babá

Ambição real de ganhar dinheiro

Conversão acima de 20%


Remuneração:

Fixo inicial: R$2.000

Progressão de fixo conforme bate metas

Comissão: 5% sobre cada contrato fechado + bônus por performance

Temos 4 SDRs dedicados + investimento pesado em tráfego.

title: Python Back End Developer
description:
Python Backend Engineer

Language: Portuguese & English

Position: Full Remote

Experience: Mid-Senior

Key Responsibilities

• Troubleshoot and resolve delivery issues across environments, including pipeline failures and data inconsistencies.

• Maintain and evolve schema-driven YAML/JSON configurations for distribution and exhibition platforms.

• Support operational workflows by updating internal Python automation scripts.

• Perform database-level investigations to validate data integrity and confirm fixes.

• Work through PR-based change management with clear documentation and regression verification.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth delivery operations.

• Apply observability and log analysis techniques to trace failures and extract actionable insights.

• Ensure compliance with schema validation and maintain configuration hygiene.


Mandatory Knowledge

• YAML/JSON (production-grade): Safe authoring/refactoring, strict structure, and change hygiene.

• Git + PR workflow: Clean diffs, review discipline, conflict handling, and controlled promotions.

• Observability & log analysis: Tracing failures across pipeline stages, correlating identifiers, and extracting actionable signals from logs/metrics.

• Schema/validation mindset: Interpreting schema/tooling errors and keeping configs compliant.

• Python: Debugging and adjusting existing scripts/automation; implementing targeted fixes safely.

• Databases (SQL): Querying to investigate production issues, validate data integrity, and confirm outcomes.

• Production support fundamentals: Incident triage, root-cause analysis, mitigations, and regression verification.

• Jinja templating: Understanding template-driven generation and making safe, minimal changes.


Optional Knowledge

• Media Supply Chain fundamentals: Deliverables, packaging concepts, metadata hierarchies, locale conventions, and downstream dependency impacts.

• Advanced mapping/config patterns (conditional/switch/lookup/padding; robust globals/locals usage).

• CI/automation improvements (linting/formatting, pre-validation checks, regression harnesses).

• Partner operations context (common rejection patterns, partner-specific exceptions, operational playbooks).

• Communication in incident/PR contexts (concise updates, change summaries, and requirement translation).


Preferred Experience

• Hands-on experience in production support for large-scale delivery platforms.

• Strong understanding of schema-driven configuration management and automation workflows.

• Maintain and evolve schema-driven YAML/JSON configurations for distribution and exhibition platforms.

• Support operational workflows by updating internal Python automation scripts.

• Perform database-level investigations to validate data integrity and confirm fixes.

• Work through PR-based change management with clear documentation and regression verification.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth delivery operations.

• Apply observability and log analysis techniques to trace failures and extract actionable insights.

• Ensure compliance with schema validation and maintain configuration hygiene.


Mandatory Knowledge

• YAML/JSON (production-grade): Safe authoring/refactoring, strict structure, and change hygiene.

• Git + PR workflow: Clean diffs, review discipline, conflict handling, and controlled promotions.

• Observability & log analysis: Tracing failures across pipeline stages, correlating identifiers, and extracting actionable signals from logs/metrics.

• Schema/validation mindset: Interpreting schema/tooling errors and keeping configs compliant.

• Python: Debugging and adjusting existing scripts/automation; implementing targeted fixes safely.

• Databases (SQL): Querying to investigate production issues, validate data integrity, and confirm outcomes.

• Production support fundamentals: Incident triage, root-cause analysis, mitigations, and regression verification.

• Jinja templating: Understanding template-driven generation and making safe, minimal changes.


Optional Knowledge

• Media Supply Chain fundamentals: Deliverables, packaging concepts, metadata hierarchies, locale conventions, and downstream dependency impacts.

• Advanced mapping/config patterns (conditional/switch/lookup/padding; robust globals/locals usage).

• CI/automation improvements (linting/formatting, pre-validation checks, regression harnesses).

• Partner operations context (common rejection patterns, partner-specific exceptions, operational playbooks).

• Communication in incident/PR contexts (concise updates, change summaries, and requirement translation).


Preferred Experience

• Hands-on experience in production support for large-scale delivery platforms.

• Strong understanding of schema-driven configuration management and automation workflows.

title: Especialista em Inteligência Artificial e Ciência de Dados
description:
Somos uma consultoria de Engenharia de Software com mais de 15 anos de experiência em qualidade de software e elevado nível técnico quando se trata de automação de testes, segurança digital e cultura DevOps.

_nunca paramos de estudar e aprender , pois estamos sempre em busca de excelência e desenvolvimento.

_valorizamos nosso ambiente colaborativo , pois acreditamos na força do nosso time.

_agimos com transparência e respeito , pois buscamos manter padrões éticos e morais nas nossas relações com colegas, parceiros e clientes.

Nosso time está crescendo. Formamos uma equipe comprometida com resultados e capaz de resolver problemas desafiadores. Venha crescer conosco!


Como Especialista na PrimeUp você:

  • Atuará na definição, desenvolvimento e implantação de projetos de IA clássica e generativa, sempre alinhados a boas práticas de governança, segurança e uso responsável de dados;
  • Será responsável pelo diagnóstico, arquitetura de soluções, apoio técnico na pré-venda de soluções, mentoria, participação na execução de projetos, além de liderança técnica e capacitação de equipe interna e usuários;
  • Terá como principais desafios:
  • Traduzir as demandas de negócios em requisitos, definindo, projetando e implantando soluções com inteligência artificial;
  • Desenvolver algoritimos criando modelos de tendência com base em um grande volume de dados com a finalidade de resolver problemas de negócio;
  • Buscar arranjos estatísticos dos dados de forma a compreender determinados fenômenos auxiliando na tomada de decisões mais assertivas;
  • Projetar soluções usando tanto modelos preditivos tradicionais quanto IA generativa;
  • Implementar e monitorar pipelines de ponta a ponta (ETL + Feature Store + Model Registry + Deploy) em MLOps/LLMOps;
  • Explorar técnicas de explainable AI (XAI) e fairness/bias detection, para garantir decisões transparentes.


Para assumir esse desafio você precisa ter:

  • Experiência sólida com criação e desenvolvimento de soluções com inteligência artificial;
  • Capacidade de comunicação com clientes e parceiros para resolução de problemas;
  • Domínio de: Métodos quantitativos (regressão, clusterin, etc); Estatística Descritiva; Governança de Dados; Big Data; Machine Learning Ops (MLOps) e Artificial Intelligence Ops (AIOps);
  • Experiência evidenciada em: Machine Learning Engines; Linguagens, LM's e APIs; Ferramentas Estatísticas; IA Frameworks; Ferramentas de Dashboard; Base de dados vetoriais.


Será bacana se você também tiver:

  • Certificações ou pós graduação na área;
  • Experiência com LangGraph;
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de automação (ex. IBM Watson Orchestrate, n8n, Zapier,...).


Obs.: A vaga é remota para candidatos fora das regiões metropolitanas de RJ e SP. Para residentes nas regiões metropolitanas de RJ e SP, o modelo é híbrido (1 vez por semana presencial).

Como parte do time da PrimeUp você terá direito a:

  • Contratação CLT com remuneração compatível ao mercado;
  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Vale Refeição;
  • Plano de Saúde;
  • Plano Odontológico;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Folga Anual Bônus;
  • Reembolso de Certificações;
  • PrimeUp Academy (rede de capacitação profissional);
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR);
  • Plano de academias;
  • Programa de Bem-Estar com auxílio psicológico, social, financeiro e jurídico.

title: Generative AI Engineer
description:
Generative AI Engineer / AI & ML Specialist


We are seeking an experienced professional with 6–8 years of hands-on expertise in Generative AI, AI/ML, and Data Science technologies. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in building production-grade solutions, implementing end-to-end Generative AI projects, and working across cloud ecosystems.


Key Responsibilities


• Design and implement Generative AI applications using advanced methodologies such as RAG, prompt engineering, embeddings, and fine-tuning.

• Develop production-grade AI/ML solutions leveraging cloud platforms like GCP Vertex AI, Azure AI, and AWS Bedrock.

• Work with structured and unstructured data to build RAG-based solutions.

• Integrate agent frameworks (e.g., Google ADK, LangGraph, CrewAI) into AI workflows.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure API integration, test automation, and adherence to software engineering best practices.

• Optimize applications for scalability and performance in cloud environments.


Required Skills & Experience

• 6–8 years of experience in AI/ML and Data Science, including 2+ years in Generative AI projects.

• Strong proficiency in Python and frameworks such as Flask and FastAPI.

• Hands-on experience with deep learning, TensorFlow, and NLP techniques.

title: Especialista de Barter
description:
RAINBOW DEFENSIVOS AGRÍCOLAS

Tudo sobre crescimento.



Somos uma empresa líder em proteção de cultivos que produz, distribui e comercializa Defensivos Agrícolas.

Somos a maior exportadora de agroquímicos da China e TOP10 indústria agroquímica global, presente em mais de 100 países nos 5 continentes, com 6 fábricas próprias e um time de especialistas focados em solucionar as necessidades dos clientes.


Estamos em expansão no Brasil e buscamos profissionais comprometidos e que enxerguem na expansão uma oportunidade de construir e transformar.


Se você quer atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, com oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento e contribuir para transformar o futuro da proteção de cultivos no país, venha fazer parte da Rainbow Defensivos Agrícolas.


  • Especialista de Barter


PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES:


  • Construir e manter relacionamento próximo com tradings e demais parceiros de Barter, garantindo alternativas competitivas de originação;
  • Atuar em conjunto com o time de Marketing para desenvolver ofertas e campanhas de Barter alinhadas à estratégia comercial;
  • Apoiar diretamente o time comercial na execução das operações, desde a negociação até o fechamento do deal;
  • Analisar propostas, validar cálculos, condições, lastro agrícola e exposição de risco;
  • Garantir a acuracidade, integridade e arquivamento correto de todos os documentos (CPRs, contratos, termos, cessões, garantias etc.);
  • Monitorar o fluxo das operações no SAP, assegurando compliance com processos internos e SLAs;
  • Acompanhar o pós-negócio, garantindo aderência ao calendário de liquidação do Barter e Apoiar treinamentos internos e disseminação de conhecimento sobre Barter para o time comercial.



REQUISITOS:


  • Graduação em Agronomia, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Atuação prévia com operações de Barter, relacionamento com tradings, análise de CPRs e documentação contratual.
  • Conhecimento no mercado agrícola, culturas e produtividade, cálculos de equivalência (sacas), avaliação de risco, noções de crédito e compliance.
  • SAP e pacote Office (Excel avançado desejável).


DESEJÁVEL:

  • MBA/Pós em Agronegócio, Finanças ou Mercado de Commodities.
  • Inglês intermediário

title: Engenheiro de software
description:
Sobre a Empresa: A Syonet é uma empresa de tecnologia especializada no desenvolvimento de soluções digitais voltadas para o setor automotivo, com foco em concessionárias. Através de sistemas de CRM, ferramentas de gestão e inteligência artificial, a Syonet promove a transformação digital, otimizando processos, melhorando a experiência do cliente e proporcionando insights estratégicos baseados em dados para aumentar a eficiência e os resultados das empresas do setor.

Sobre o cargo: Como Engenheiro de software Pleno, você vai atuar diretamente no desenvolvimento e manutenção de sistemas, APIs e serviços que compõem a o ecossistema de produtos da empresa.


Responsabilidades Principais:

  • Criar e manter APIs/Serviços, garantindo performance, segurança e escalabilidade.
  • Identificar e corrigir bugs, além de otimizar sistemas para melhorar a performance.
  • Trabalhar na integração de sistemas internos e de terceiros.
  • Participar de reuniões para entendimento de requisitos, refinamento de demandas e planejamento de sprints.
  • Escrever testes automatizados (unitários, integração e end-to-end) para garantir a estabilidade das entregas.
  • Monitorar sistemas/serviços em produção, analisando logs e métricas para garantir a estabilidade e desempenho dos serviços.
  • Implementar boas práticas de segurança no desenvolvimento, proteção de dados e autenticação de sistemas.
  • Em conjunto com a liderança técnica e arquitetura, avaliar e propor novas ferramentas, tecnologias e práticas para melhorar o ecossistema da empresa
  • Documentar processos e melhorias implementadas.


Requisitos:

  • Graduação ou último ano da graduação na área de TI;
  • No mínimo, 3 anos de experiencia como desenvolvedor de software;
  • Conhecimentos de CSS, JavaScript e frameworks para frontend como React e Next.js ;
  • Entender a sintaxe da linguagem Ruby e Node ;
  • Conhecer o framework Ruby on Rails e seus componentes;
  • Experiência com Node.js para desenvolvimento backend;
  • Conhecimento em NestJS para desenvolvimento de APIs e serviços backend;
  • Conhecer bancos de dados relacionais, como PostgreSQL e não relacionais como MongoDB;
  • Conhecimento de container (Docker, Kubernetes );
  • Conhecer ferramentas de versionamento de código como Git;
  • Conhecer metodologias ágeis, como Scrum ou Kanban;
  • Conhecer design de APIs RESTful;
  • Conhecer Redis, Elasticsearch, Sidekiq, RabbitMQ e Google Cloud ;
  • Experiência com testes automatizados, utilizando RSpec e Jest;



Será um diferencial!

  • Já ter trabalhado com envio de e-mail marketing ;
  • Experiência com SendGrid .


VAGA 100% REMOTA!



Por que #VemParaSyonet ? Temos um ambiente diverso, colaborativo e focado na qualidade e cheio de oportunidades para crescer com a gente

title: Deployment Reliability Engineer
description:
Your role and responsabilities:


  • Manage continuous delivery and configuration of SAP Ariba Cloud products using modern deployment tools.
  • Respond quickly to deployment requests and provide technical support for the SAP Ariba suite.
  • Collaborate with engineering subject matter experts to ensure seamless operations.
  • Handle user tickets and change requests within defined SLAs.
  • Automate manual tasks to improve scalability and efficiency.
  • Lead complex deployment projects including new site setups and disaster recovery planning.
  • Manage certificate renewals and troubleshoot related issues.
  • Document SOPs and apply ITIL best practices.


Requiriments and Qualifications:


  • Experience in a Unix/Linux environment.
  • Familiar with SAP Ariba Cloud products
  • Proven experience in 24x7 enterprise environments.
  • Hands-on expertise with cloud provisioning (preferably GCP and AWS).
  • Proficiency in Terraform and CI/CD tools like Jenkins, Artifactory, Docker, Vault.
  • Development experience in Python, Go, or Groovy.
  • Strong knowledge of system applications (Apache, DNS, SSH, TCP/IP, NFS).
  • Deep understanding of OS internals and file system structures.
  • Experience with certificate management and scripting (Perl, Python, Shell).
  • Basic knowledge of HANA database administration.
  • Excellent communication, analytical, and multitasking skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree in MIS, CS, or equivalent experience.
  • Advanced English

title: Engenheiro de Dados III
description:
Sobre a DataEX:

Com 12 anos de atuação no mercado, a DataEX é uma consultoria especializada em Dados e IA , com parcerias estratégicas com Microsoft, AWS e Databricks , atuando em projetos de alto impacto para grandes clientes. Valorizamos a inovação, a colaboração, o desenvolvimento contínuo e a qualidade de vida , com incentivos para certificações e bem-estar.


Sobre a vaga:

Estamos a procura de profissionais parceiros para contribuir com o Projeto em Dados em um dos nossos maiores clientes!


Requisitos:

• Experiência com data lakes, data mesh e recursos da AWS , incluindo AWS Glue, kinesis, Redshift, Athena, Aurora e S3.

• Capacidade de criar APIs e desenvolver utilizando PySpark no Databricks / EMR.

• Experiência com alocação de recursos em clusters na AWS.

• Desenvolvimento e manutenção de pipelines de dados (Arquitetura Lambda ).

• Gestão de arquitetura de dados (camadas raw, bronze, silver, gold).

• Documentação e transferência de conhecimento dos pipelines desenvolvidos.

• Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban e Lean).

• Habilidades de comunicação , colaboração , resolução de problemas e pensamento crítico.

• Adaptabilidade e flexibilidade a mudanças.

description:

  • Execute and maintain operational workflows for cross-border payments (including fiat and stablecoin transactions) and VASP activities.
  • Monitor transaction costs, identify inefficiencies, and propose improvements to enhance operational performance.
  • Manage daily financial operations, including accounts payable/receivable, cash flow tracking, and crypto/stablecoin fund movements.
  • Maintain detailed records of all virtual asset activities to ensure compliance with internal
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal risk controls, including KYB/KYC/AML checks, reporting, and audit readiness.

  • Develop and implement scalable SOPs and operational tools to support business growth, ensuring reliability and consistency across markets.

  • 3+ years of experience in operations, financial operations, or crypto-related back-office roles, preferably in fintech or Web3 environments.
  • Solid understanding of stablecoins, blockchain-based payment flows, and operational risk.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks with attention to detail.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English; proficiency in Spanish and Mandarin is a plus.


What we offer:

  • Competitive salary and benefits.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.
  • A collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • The chance to work on cutting-edge blockchain technology and make a significant impact in the industry.


Preferred Qualifications: proficiency in Spanish and Mandarin is a plus

title: Engineer Manager
description:
Remoto | Grupo SBF | Ecossistema do Esporte


Estamos em busca de um(a) Engineering Manager para liderar nossas equipes de engenharia com foco em excelência técnica, impacto nos negócios e desenvolvimento de pessoas. Essa é uma posição estratégica de liderança, com responsabilidade direta sobre entregas, pessoas e processos.

Se você tem paixão por formar times de alta performance, toma decisões baseadas em dados e sabe equilibrar visão técnica e foco em pessoas, essa vaga pode ser sua próxima jornada!


O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência prévia em posições de liderança à frente de mais de um contexto;
  • Sólida experiência em desenvolvimento de software;
  • Histórico de entregas com impacto real (eficiência, performance, redução de custo ou aumento de satisfação);
  • Conhecimento avançado em arquitetura de software, sistemas distribuídos e metodologias ágeis ;
  • Familiaridade com métricas de times de engenharia (DORA Metrics ou similares);
  • Experiência com sistemas críticos e em escala ;
  • Habilidade de comunicação clara, objetiva e empática ;
  • Capacidade de liderar e desenvolver times diversos , promovendo um ambiente seguro , colaborativo e de crescimento ;
  • Visão sistêmica e foco em resolver problemas complexos com inovação e senso de urgência.


O que você vai fazer:

  • Liderar times de engenharia, garantindo entregas estratégicas com qualidade e alinhamento aos objetivos da empresa;
  • Atuar próximo a Produto, Design, Segurança e Infraestrutura para garantir sinergia e integração nas entregas;
  • Ser responsável por desenvolvimento de pessoas, feedbacks, mentoring e formação de cultura;
  • Participar de decisões técnicas relevantes, com foco em escalabilidade, confiabilidade e performance;
  • Gerenciar orçamento, riscos e priorizações, com capacidade de adaptação e liderança em momentos de crise;
  • Promover boas práticas de engenharia, cultura de experimentação e aprendizagem contínua.


✨ Diferenciais que somam pontos:

  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência anterior em e-commerce ou ambientes de larga escala;
  • Participação em iniciativas de transformação organizacional ou melhoria contínua;
  • Publicações técnicas, participação em comunidades, eventos ou contribuições open source;
  • Familiaridade com frameworks de segurança (OWASP, NIST, ISO/IEC 27001) e atuação com Security Champions.


—

Se interessou?

title: Tech Lead Plataforma e SRE
description:
O Mercado Eletrônico é líder na América Latina em soluções de gestão de compras B2B. Suas tecnologias e serviços para as áreas de compras ajudam empresas a conquistarem mais economia, agilidade, governança e colaboração.

Com escritórios no Brasil, Estados Unidos, México e Portugal, contabiliza mais de 1 milhão de fornecedores, 10 mil compradores e transaciona um valor acima de R$ 160 bilhões em negócios anualmente. É a única empresa latino-americana a fazer parte do Quadrante Mágico S2P (source-to-pay), do Gartner.


Tech Lead - Plataforma e SRE

contratação CLT


Gosta de desafios técnicos de alta complexidade, arquitetura escalável e resolver problemas de infraestrutura em escala? Aqui você vai liderar tecnicamente soluções em Kubernetes, observabilidade de ponta, automação e práticas modernas de SRE, garantindo alta disponibilidade e performance dos nossos sistemas.


Quais serão suas responsabilidades neste desafio?

  • Liderar tecnicamente a arquitetura e evolução da plataforma, definindo padrões e boas práticas de SRE e DevOps.
  • Projetar e implementar soluções resilientes, escaláveis e de alta disponibilidade em ambientes cloud e híbridos.
  • Definir e implementar estratégias de CI/CD, automação e Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
  • Estabelecer práticas de observabilidade, definir SLOs e implementar monitoramento avançado (Prometheus, Grafana LGTM, OpenTelemetry).
  • Otimizar performance, reduzir MTTR e atuar na resolução de incidentes críticos com análise de causa raiz.
  • Automatizar processos operacionais e de infraestrutura (IaC, pipelines, deploys).
  • Assegurar práticas de DevSecOps, implementando segurança desde o desenvolvimento até a produção.
  • Disseminar conhecimento técnico e promover boas práticas no time através de code reviews, RFCs e documentação técnica.
  • Gerenciar custos e otimizar recursos na nuvem.


Será bacana se você tiver:

  • Experiência sólida com práticas de SRE e alta disponibilidade.
  • Experiência avançada em Cloud (AWS, OCI ou multi-cloud) e ambientes híbridos.
  • Experiência avançada com Linux e administração de sistemas.
  • Domínio de Kubernetes, containers e orquestração (Docker, Helm, etc.).
  • Proficiência em Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible ou similares).
  • Experiência com CI/CD moderno (GitLab, ArgoCD, Jenkins ou similares).
  • Forte conhecimento em observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana LGTM, OTel, ELK).
  • Automação e scripting avançado (Python, Go ou Bash/Shell).
  • Práticas de DevSecOps e segurança em nuvem.
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas de alto impacto e arquiteturais.
  • Comunicação técnica eficaz para interação com times multidisciplinares.
  • Perfil analítico e resolutivo para troubleshooting e otimização de sistemas complexos.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com Chaos Engineering e testes de resiliência.
  • Vivência com FinOps e otimização de custos na nuvem.

title: Tech Lead Plataforma e SRE
description:
O Mercado Eletrônico é líder na América Latina em soluções de gestão de compras B2B. Suas tecnologias e serviços para as áreas de compras ajudam empresas a conquistarem mais economia, agilidade, governança e colaboração.

Com escritórios no Brasil, Estados Unidos, México e Portugal, contabiliza mais de 1 milhão de fornecedores, 10 mil compradores e transaciona um valor acima de R$ 160 bilhões em negócios anualmente. É a única empresa latino-americana a fazer parte do Quadrante Mágico S2P (source-to-pay), do Gartner.


Tech Lead - Plataforma e SRE

contratação CLT


Gosta de desafios técnicos de alta complexidade, arquitetura escalável e resolver problemas de infraestrutura em escala? Aqui você vai liderar tecnicamente soluções em Kubernetes, observabilidade de ponta, automação e práticas modernas de SRE, garantindo alta disponibilidade e performance dos nossos sistemas.


Quais serão suas responsabilidades neste desafio?

  • Liderar tecnicamente a arquitetura e evolução da plataforma, definindo padrões e boas práticas de SRE e DevOps.
  • Projetar e implementar soluções resilientes, escaláveis e de alta disponibilidade em ambientes cloud e híbridos.
  • Definir e implementar estratégias de CI/CD, automação e Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
  • Estabelecer práticas de observabilidade, definir SLOs e implementar monitoramento avançado (Prometheus, Grafana LGTM, OpenTelemetry).
  • Otimizar performance, reduzir MTTR e atuar na resolução de incidentes críticos com análise de causa raiz.
  • Automatizar processos operacionais e de infraestrutura (IaC, pipelines, deploys).
  • Assegurar práticas de DevSecOps, implementando segurança desde o desenvolvimento até a produção.
  • Disseminar conhecimento técnico e promover boas práticas no time através de code reviews, RFCs e documentação técnica.
  • Gerenciar custos e otimizar recursos na nuvem.


Será bacana se você tiver:

  • Experiência sólida com práticas de SRE e alta disponibilidade.
  • Experiência avançada em Cloud (AWS, OCI ou multi-cloud) e ambientes híbridos.
  • Experiência avançada com Linux e administração de sistemas.
  • Domínio de Kubernetes, containers e orquestração (Docker, Helm, etc.).
  • Proficiência em Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible ou similares).
  • Experiência com CI/CD moderno (GitLab, ArgoCD, Jenkins ou similares).
  • Forte conhecimento em observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana LGTM, OTel, ELK).
  • Automação e scripting avançado (Python, Go ou Bash/Shell).
  • Práticas de DevSecOps e segurança em nuvem.
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas de alto impacto e arquiteturais.
  • Comunicação técnica eficaz para interação com times multidisciplinares.
  • Perfil analítico e resolutivo para troubleshooting e otimização de sistemas complexos.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com Chaos Engineering e testes de resiliência.
  • Vivência com FinOps e otimização de custos na nuvem.

title: Sr. Mobile Engineer
description:
Who We Are:

PureSpectrum is a rapidly growing market research and insights platform that simplifies technology, allowing researchers to gather and activate consumer data without disruption. As the go-to solution for high-quality multi-sourcing and fully automated research, PureSpectrum is helping to shape the future of insights.


Our Marketplace facilitates over 65 million online interviews annually, and our proprietary respondent-level scoring system—PureScore—continues to set the industry standard for data quality and reliability.


Recognized globally for both innovation and culture, PureSpectrum has been named one of Newsweek’s Global Most Loved Workplaces (2023–2025), included in Inc.’s Best Workplaces ), certified as a Great Place to Work (2022–2025), and featured on Built In’s Best Places to Work list (2023–2025). PS is rapidly becoming the leading solution for quality multi-sourcing and end-to-end automated research solution.


The Opportunity:

PureSpectrum is seeking a Senior Engineer to join our high-impact Product & Engineering team of passionate engineers. You will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining a mobile application. This is a fast-paced role within our global Product & Engineering organization, reporting directly to the Engineering Manager.


The ideal candidate is technically strong, detail-oriented, and thrives in a collaborative, agile environment. You’ll work closely with cross-functional stakeholders—including product managers, QA engineers, and developers across geographies—to deliver scalable, reliable, and innovative solutions.


Your Responsibilities:

  • Build modern, performant mobile applications for iOS and Android using Flutter.
  • Implement client-side data consumption and display for new features utilizing RESTful API endpoints using .NET core.
  • Test drive development and write Unit/Integration tests
  • Design and optimize database structure using MySQL and write optimized queries for better performance.
  • Follow best practices in version control (Git), CI/CD and cloud deployments.
  • Drive team performance by leading and empowering members to develop and execute innovative solutions.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a similar discipline from any recognized University.
  • 3-5 years of hands-on experience with mobile development technologies, ideally Flutter/Dart.
  • Experience with Firebase.
  • Experience of building back-end applications using .NET Core and ORM like Entity Framework (or other Object-Oriented language/ORM).
  • Experience with MVC and MVVM design patterns.
  • Knowledge of C#, Dart, JSON, Git, HTML, YAML, REST.
  • Knowledge of Linux and command line.
  • AWS Cloud Expertise: Proven experience designing, deploying, and maintaining scalable and reliable cloud solutions leveraging core AWS services, including EC2/Beanstalk, RDS, SQS, SES, SNS, S3 and Lambda.
  • Strong understanding of relational databases, preference to MySQL)
  • Knowledge of build pipelines (e.g., AWS CodePipeline, Bitbucket, GitLab)
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills


Nice to Have

  • Experience in Agile/Scrum teams
  • Comfort with fast-moving teams
  • Comfort with working across time zones and with distributed teams
  • Knowledge of Shell script, JavaScript, and Native mobile development for Android/iOS is a plus.


PureSpectrum Perks:

Join PureSpectrum and become part of our innovative culture (PSX), where we prioritize your professional growth and foster a strong sense of team connection. You'll be part of a rewarding, high-standard environment where team members genuinely enjoy regular celebrations and events—a truly exceptional experience at every level.


PureSpectrum is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will not be discriminated against because of race, color, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, citizenship status, disability, ancestry, marital status, veteran status, medical condition, or any protected category prohibited under the law.

title: Technical Support Consultant L3
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Technical Support Consultant with 3 to 5 years of software support experience to join the client operations team of our U.S. client. You will play a critical role in ensuring our client's software lives up to its world-class reputation.

Our client provides a cloud-based, ERP platform to hundreds of energy industry customers delivering market-leading field service management, field data gathering, transportation, production, accounting, and land software solutions. Backed by private equity, our client accelerates business performance, improves operational efficiency, and reduces costs.


Responsibilities

  • Deliver Level 3 customer support for our client's industry-leading software products
  • Triage reported, end-user customer incidents
  • Work technical issues and support the direct client feedback loop process
  • Help secure existing revenue by means of customer retention
  • Provide incident queue management
  • Utilize troubleshooting skills
  • Help manage complex issues and drive escalations to resolution
  • Build and demonstrate cross-application knowledge among the client's core application modules
  • Push the client's software to the limit, making sure it is efficient, intuitive, and best-in-class
  • Gain experience in the oil and gas industry; including economic, accounting, and finance knowledge


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written skills
  • 3 to 5 years of Level 3 software support experience
  • Basic to intermediate SQL skills
  • Proficiency in using Microsoft Office Suite
  • A drive to continue learning in the energy business and the client's software
  • Advanced problem-solving skills
  • Ability to triage and actively manage a support queue
  • Innate passion for customer service
  • Dependability and ability to manage as well as prioritize concurrent tasks
  • Must be available for an on-call rotation
  • Ability to work U.S. CST business hours
  • Must be a self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Proven experience working effectively in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • Experience creating manuals, training documentation, and interactive training materials for software applications
  • Experience providing software support and troubleshooting for SaaS applications
  • Experience in reproducing issues in a test environment prior to production deployment
  • Experience in the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)
  • Experience with oil and gas revenue accounting, gas processing, crude/gas/NGL transportation, or related fields


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Senior Software Engineer  (PHP and WordPress)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Software Engineer with 5+ years of development experience and deep WordPress expertise to design, build, and maintain scalable, high-quality web applications and platforms. The role focuses on advanced WordPress development, including custom plugin development, hooks/APIs, and database optimization, while leveraging modern PHP and JavaScript practices.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for solving complex engineering problems, improving performance and architecture, and ensuring that all code meets defined quality standards. Working closely with product, UX, and front-end teams, translating designs into performant, accessible, and secure user experiences while integrating WordPress with external systems, databases, and services.

As a senior engineer, you will serve as a subject-matter expert in WordPress and modern web technologies, enforce development standards, and mentor junior engineers on WordPress best practices, scalable architecture, and maintainable code design.

Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class Property Management System that integrates booking, guest communications, and financial reporting, all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain custom WordPress plugins using WordPress hooks, APIs, and database architecture
  • Implement and extend WordPress functionality while ensuring performance, security, and scalability
  • Develop server-side functionality using PHP and modern PHP frameworks/libraries such as Zend Framework, Laminas, Laravel, Symfony, and Doctrine
  • Collaborate on front-end development using JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and frameworks such as React and/or Angular
  • Design and implement scalable application architectures, including lar-specific architecture and scalability considerations
  • Experience writing and maintaining unit tests for PHP and WordPress-based applications, including automated test suites, coverage thresholds, and CI/CD integration.
  • Ensure accessibility standards, security best practices, and compliance across applications
  • Implement secure user authentication and authorization across multiple systems, servers, and environments
  • Design, query, and optimize SQL and NoSQL databases in support of WordPress-driven applications


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • Experience in WordPress plug-in development, WordPress hooks/APIs, WordPress Databases
  • Strong knowledge of PHP web frameworks/libraries (e.g., Zend Framework, Laminas, Laravel, Symfony, Doctrine)
  • Strong understanding of software design patterns and architectural principles (including MVC), front-end technologies (e.g., JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, LAR), accessibility and security compliance, scalable application design and deployment, and authentication and authorization across distributed systems and environments.
  • Familiarity with SQL/NoSQL databases and their declarative query pages with relation to WordPress
  • Proficient understanding of code versioning tools, such as Git, GitHub
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or some technical engineering
  • Familiarity with static analysis, code quality, and testing tools used to enforce coding standards, architectural rules, and test coverage (e.g., PHP static analysis, linting, and coverage reporting tools)
  • Experience with Nginix or Apache
  • Experience with AWS or other cloud providers
  • Knowledge of AI toolsets and toolkits
  • Experience with JavaScript/React in relation to Gutenberg

title: Liferay Developer (Temporary Contract)
description:
About you

You are someone who wants to influence your own development. You’re looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests and be able to grow professionally.


  • Note: This is a 3-month contract position with the possibility of extension , based on performance and project needs.


You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Computer Science or Computer Engineering.
  • 6+ years of professional experience working with Java-based platforms .
  • Hands-on experience with Liferay DXP as both administrator and developer.
  • Proven experience performing Liferay upgrades, deployments, and DevOps-related tasks .
  • Strong fundamentals in Java, JSP, and Portlet development .
  • Experience integrating Okta with Liferay , including OIDC-based authentication and user synchronization .
  • Solid background in performance tuning and remediation of technical debt in enterprise portals.
  • Familiarity with version control systems (Git ).
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and containerized environments.
  • English is a requirement, as you will be working directly with US-based clients.
  • Experience working in Linux environments with Tomcat and MySQL is a plus.
  • Working knowledge of REST API integrations and Spring-based services supporting Liferay is a plus.


You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Lead and support initiatives to address accumulated technical debt, including Liferay DXP upgrades and performance improvements.
  • Implement and maintain identity integrations between Liferay and Okta, migrating authentication flows to OIDC standards.
  • Manage DevOps processes for Liferay DXP deployments, ensuring stable and repeatable releases.
  • Contribute to custom portal development as required by the business.
  • Collaborate in architectural refinement and solution design for scalable, high-traffic environments.
  • Apply agile practices while working independently and as part of a cross-functional team.
  • Participate in documentation efforts throughout the SDLC to ensure platform maintainability and knowledge continuity.


Qualifications

  • Hands-on Liferay DXP experience.
  • Proven Liferay DevOps for upgrades and deployments.
  • Liferay performance tuning.
  • Okta integration experience.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*


*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

title: Data Pipeline Engineer
description:
About YipitData:

YipitData is the market-leading data and analytics firm. We analyze billions of data points every day to provide accurate, detailed insights across industries, including consumer brands, technology, software, and healthcare.

Our insights team uses proprietary technology to identify, license, clean, and analyze the data that many of the world’s largest investment funds and corporations depend on. We raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation over $1B, further accelerating our growth and market impact.

We have been recognized multiple times as one of Inc’s Best Workplaces. As a fast-growing company backed by The Carlyle Group and Norwest Venture Partners, YipitData is driven by a people-first culture rooted in mastery, ownership, and transparency.

With offices in New York, Austin, Miami, Denver, Mountain View, Seattle, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, and Singapore, we continue to expand our reach and impact across global markets.


Why You Should Apply NOW:

We are seeking a highly skilled Data Pipeline Engineer to join our dynamic Data Engineering team. The ideal candidate possesses 4+ years of data engineering experience. An excellent candidate should have a solid understanding of Spark, SQL, and data pipeline experience. This individual will play a crucial role in supporting our strategic pipelines and optimizing for reliability, efficiency, and performance.

Hired individuals will play a crucial role in helping to shape our ETL strategy and be part of a rapidly growing team. In this role, you will be responsible for researching, planning, and implementing best practices that optimize data pipeline performance and reliability across our organization. You will work cross-functionally with all of our product teams to ensure smooth, efficient, and scalable pipelines. This position is ideal for someone who loves tackling complex technical challenges, enjoys hands-on problem-solving, and loves the fast-paced environment where they can make a big impact.


As Our Data Engineer, You Will:

  • Report directly to the Director of Data Engineering, who will provide significant, hands-on training on cutting-edge data tools and techniques.
  • Build end-to-end data pipelines.
  • Help with setting best practices for our data modeling and pipeline builds.
  • Create documentation, architecture diagrams, and other training materials for analysts.
  • Become an expert at solving complex data pipeline issues using PySpark and SQL.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to incorporate business logic into our central pipelines.
  • Deeply learn Databricks, Airflow, and other ETL tooling.

You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related technical discipline.
  • You have 4+ years of experience as a Data Engineer, or in other technical functions.
  • You are comfortable working with large-scale datasets using PySpark or Pandas .
  • You have a great understanding of working with data, orchestration tools, and data pipelines.
  • You understand business needs and the rationale behind different data ingestion and delivery strategies.
  • You are eager to constantly learn new technologies.
  • You are a self-starter who enjoys working with both internal and external stakeholders.
  • You have exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
  • Nice to have: Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, or equivalent.


What We Offer:

  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package
  • Remote work


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

title: Supply Chain Analyst - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to join our team and help drive our growth. As a Supply Chain Analyst, you will play a critical and active role in the day-to-day operations. This is an excellent opportunity to be one of the key members of our team and position yourself for unique career growth opportunities.


Key responsibilities:


- Determine supply needs for products and services and research potential suppliers.

- Act as a link and communicate pricing and performance needs to vendors and suppliers.

- Participate in negotiations of favorable procurement contracts and prices with selected vendors and suppliers.

- Select the most suitable suppliers in terms of reliability, product quality, and cost-efficiency.

- Maintain and update a list of suppliers and their qualifications, delivery times, and potential future development.

- Prepare cost-benefit analysis reports for review by managers.


Requirements:


- 2+ years of experience in a supply management role or related position.

- Knowledge of SAP or SAP B1.

- Degree in supply chain management, logistics, business management, or related fields.

- Experience in managing inventory.

- Proficiency in SQL analysis tools and mathematical analysis.

- Interpersonal skills and ability to build and improve trust.

- Advanced level of English.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

  • Collaborate with DevOps and security teams for deployments and upgrades

description:

Overview of the role:


The Node Developer position requires a problem solver who combines experience, knowledge, and independence to tackle complex tasks. This role involves architecting backend systems, implementing features at a rapid pace, and contributing to building a world-class engineering team while maintaining high standards of code quality and innovation.


Key responsibilities:


- Architecting backend systems using best practices.

- Implementing and iterating features strategically.

- Working collaboratively and efficiently across functional teams in a fast-paced early-stage startup environment.

- Designing, extending, and implementing APIs.

- Maintaining high engineering quality standards through code reviews, unit tests, and analytics.

- Improving engineering productivity through automation and tool development.

- Defining engineering processes for product launches and releases.

- Helping grow the engineering team by conducting technical interviews.

- Node.js Experience: 5+ years of experience in Node development.

- Database Skills: Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases.

- Architecture Knowledge: Experience with microservices and cloud platforms.

- Algorithm Proficiency: Advanced algorithm knowledge.

- Infrastructure Understanding: IT infrastructure knowledge.

- Agile Methodology: Intermediate agile methodologies management.

- Best Practices: Strong understanding of SOLID principles, clean code, and scalable solutions.

- Design Patterns: Knowledge of software design patterns.

- Application Development: Experience developing entire applications from scratch.

- Testing & Deployment: Experience in automated tests and CI/CD pipelines.

- Version Control: Strong experience with version control systems.

- Language Skills: Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Viral video content creator
description:
Looking for a Viral Video Scriptwriter + Editor who can consistently create viral-style performance video ads using AI tools at scale. You will own the output like it’s your channel, not a “tasks” role.

We run performance marketing campaigns and need a steady pipeline of fresh, high-converting video creatives for the US consumer.

Mission for this job

Own the end-to-end creative pipeline for short-form video ads:

  • Research the market and audience
  • Write scripts that hook hard and hold attention
  • Edit fast, clean videos using AI + simple editing tools
  • Ship volume, learn from results, and iterate daily
What success looks likeFirst 30 days
  • Learn our offers, compliance guardrails, and what “good” looks like for us.
  • Deliver a consistent daily output of scripts + edited videos (with clear naming and organization).
  • Build a repeatable workflow using AI tools for speed (script, voice, visuals, editing, captions).
  • Show you can research the US consumer and write in natural, native-sounding English.
By 90 days
  • Ship a reliable volume of creatives every week with clear variation by hook, angle, and structure.
  • Consistently produce multiple “winners” per month (videos we can scale spend behind).
  • Maintain a simple testing system: what you tried, what worked, what failed, and what to do next.
  • Become independent: you don’t wait for perfect direction to move.
By 12 months

title: Recrutador executivo
description:
Executive Recruiter (Fluent English – C1/C2) | 100% Remote | US Market


A Blue Dot BPO conecta talentos estratégicos da América Latina a operações críticas de empresas norte-americanas. Estamos expandindo nossa atuação e buscamos um(a) Executive Recruiter para conduzir processos executivos de alto impacto , atuando diretamente com lideranças sêniores dos Estados Unidos.

Esta é uma posição 100% remota , com alto grau de autonomia, exposição internacional e responsabilidade ponta a ponta nos processos de recrutamento.


O que oferecemos

  • Remuneração fixa mensal de R$ 5.000 , com bônus adicionais em dólares
  • Trabalho remoto integral (segunda a sexta, 13h às 22h BRT )
  • Contrato de longo prazo e oportunidades reais de crescimento
  • Atuação estratégica junto a executivos e times C-level nos EUA
  • Ambiente multicultural, orientado a performance, processos e meritocracia


Responsabilidades

  • Conduzir recrutamento full-cycle para posições executivas
  • Desenvolver sourcing avançado e mapeamento de mercado
  • Realizar entrevistas estruturadas e pré-qualificação profunda
  • Gerenciar pipelines estratégicos e relacionamento com stakeholders
  • Coordenar entrevistas com equipes norte-americanas
  • Garantir excelência operacional em ATS e dados de recrutamento


O que buscamos

  • 2+ anos de experiência em recrutamento executivo/hunting
  • Inglês fluente (C1/C2 ) para interação diária
  • Perfil hunter, analítico e orientado a resultados
  • Domínio de LinkedIn Recruiter, ATS e job boards
  • Comunicação sólida, postura consultiva e alto nível de organização


Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia em executive recruiting de ciclo completo.
  • Familiaridade com práticas e mercado de recrutamento norte-americano.



Requisitos técnicos

  • Notebook com processador i7 (ou equivalente) e 12GB+ RAM .
  • Dois monitores para rotina operacional.
  • Internet de alta velocidade.
  • Headset profissional.
  • Ambiente silencioso e estruturado para trabalho remoto.


Construa sua carreira internacional!


Se você deseja atuar diretamente com o mercado dos EUA, desenvolver experiência executiva e crescer em um ambiente orientado a alta performance, evolução contínua e consistência, esta oportunidade é para você. Candidate-se e faça parte da Blue Dot BPO

title: Cientista de Dados Senior (IA)
description:
Descrição do cargo

Estamos em busca de um(a) Senior AI / ML Engineer para liderar o desenvolvimento e a implantação de soluções de Inteligência Artificial e Machine Learning em escala. Essa pessoa será protagonista na construção do nosso ecossistema de IA, atuando com GenAI, NLP, visão computacional, entre outros, com impacto direto em produtos, processos e decisões estratégicas da empresa.

Propósito da posição


Você será responsável por transformar dados em decisões inteligentes, liderando frentes técnicas e estratégicas com foco em inovação, eficiência e impacto real no negócio.

Responsabilidades

  • Liderar projetos, integrações e fundações de ciência de dados e IA, trabalhando em colaboração com áreas envolvidas.
  • Propor, construir e acompanhar soluções fim a fim: desde o mapeamento da necessidade, proposição e desenho de solução, exploração do dados, treinamento, produtização e escala do modelo, análise e monitoramento dos seus resultados, além do acompanhamento do seu ciclo e consumo, garantindo pontos de condução ética e legal.
  • Evoluir o ecossistema de Data & AI para que esteja saudável, atualizado e à frente do mercado, com construção conjunta com áreas parceiras como Arquiteturas, Engenharias de Aplicações, Sustentação, Negócios e Riscos.
  • Estabelecer, guiar e avaliar melhores prática, capabilities, engines, aceleradores, padrões e frameworks em cases e soluções técnicas,
  • Avaliar, aplicar e disseminar boas práticas de governança, ética, justiça, explicabilidade, segurança e compliance em modelos de IA.
  • Conduzir e estabelecendo um grande Centro de Excelência habilitador de jornada com responsabilidade.
  • Criar parcerias e manter proximidade com Big Techs, alianças e universidades criando programas e laboratórios como parte evolutiva do ecossistema.
  • Colaborar ativamente com Data Strategy alinhada ao Business Strategy e tendências de mercado, construindo a visão de business x technical capabilities.
  • Contribuir em frentes culturais com o propósito de educar, capacitar, conscientizar, além de elevar o nível de maturidade em dados e IA na organização


Técnicas

  • Desenvolver e operacionalizar modelos de IA e ML em ambientes de produção.
  • Criar e manter pipelines de dados e ML com foco em escalabilidade e governança.
  • Atuar com modelos supervisionados, não supervisionados, GenAI, NLP, LLMs e sistemas de recomendação.
  • Monitorar e ajustar modelos em produção para garantir performance e acurácia.

Estratégicas e culturais

  • Liderar iniciativas técnicas e contribuir para a visão de IA na companhia.
  • Disseminar boas práticas de IA responsável (fairness, explicabilidade, compliance).
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com arquitetura, produto, dados e áreas de negócio.
  • Apoiar a formação de um CoE de IA e promover a maturidade analítica da organização.
  • Conectar a estratégia de dados com a estratégia de negócio.

Stack técnica

  • Linguagens: Python (obrigatório), SQL
  • Bibliotecas: Scikit-Learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Transformers (Hugging Face), OpenAI, Llama LLM
  • MLOps: MLflow, DVC, Airflow, CI/CD

Plataformas: Databricks, Azure (preferencial), AWS ou GCP

  • Bancos: Delta Lake, SQL, NoSQL
  • Ferramentas de visualização: Power BI


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Inglês avançado
  • 5+ anos de experiência com ciência de dados e IA em produção
  • Proficiência em Python e bibliotecas de ML/IA
  • Experiência com MLOps, deploy de modelos e monitoramento
  • Conhecimento em modelos generativos (LLMs, embeddings & orchestration, prompt engineering)
  • Experiência com pipelines em cloud (preferencialmente Azure/Databricks)
  • Forte capacidade analítica e habilidade de traduzir problemas de negócio em soluções técnicas
  • Habilidade para trabalhar de forma colaborativa e gerenciar múltiplas prioridades.
  • Familiaridade com frameworks de referência de governança de IA (envolvendo pontos como Responsible AI, AI Fairness).

Diferenciais

  • Compartilhar o GitHub ou qualquer outro repositório de portfolio para conhecermos seu trabalho
  • Experiência com time series, recomendação e modelos de visão computacional
  • Atuação prévia em CoEs ou iniciativas de IA Corporativa
  • Pós-graduação, certificações ou publicações relevantes

Se você quer trabalhar com IA de verdade, com liberdade para inovar e gerar impacto, essa vaga é pra você!!!

title: Senior Project Manager (Software Development)
description:
For Brazil Only, PJ contract, Fluent English


Job Title: Senior Project Manager (Software Development)


Type: Full-Time


About Indigo Beam

Indigo Beam is a digital transformation consulting firm dedicated to helping organizations evolve their business through modern technology solutions. We partner with our clients to improve customer experience, reengineer operational workflows, modernize legacy systems, and unlock data-driven insights that power smarter decision-making. Our services span Content Management, ERP, Digital Modernization, GIS & BI, CRM, and AI—helping businesses not just react to change, but lead it.


Key Responsibilities:

Leadership & Team Management:

  • Lead and manage cross-functional teams, including Technical Architects, Developers, QA, and Business Analysts, ensuring high performance and alignment with project goals.
  • Provide mentorship and guidance to team members, fostering a collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • Oversee the team's daily operations, ensuring tasks are completed on time and within scope.


Project Management:

  • Develop, maintain, and execute detailed project plans, schedules, and budgets.
  • Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously, with a focus on application/software development.
  • Own and facilitate project status meetings, adjusting project targets and schedules as needed.


Microsoft DevOps Project Management:

  • Manage and configure sprints, backlogs, and work items within Microsoft DevOps to ensure project transparency and alignment with Agile methodologies.
  • Track and manage user stories and epics, ensuring they are well-defined, prioritized, and aligned with project goals.
  • Facilitate daily stand-ups (scrums), sprint planning, and sprint retrospectives to ensure team collaboration and continuous improvement.
  • Monitor and manage burndown charts and other Agile metrics to track project progress and ensure timely delivery.
  • Collaborate with team members to ensure DevOps practices support efficient project execution and align with client needs.


Business Analysis:

  • Perform business analysis tasks on projects as needed, including requirements gathering, process mapping, and stakeholder interviews.
  • Ensure business requirements are clearly defined, documented, and communicated to technical teams.


Client Engagement:

  • Serve as clients' primary point of contact, ensuring their needs and expectations are met.
  • Communicate project progress, risks, and issues effectively to clients and stakeholders.
  • Ensure client satisfaction by delivering projects that meet or exceed their requirements.


Technical Oversight:

  • Collaborate with Technical Architects to ensure project designs align with business objectives and technical standards.
  • Review and approve technical and business documentation, ensuring completeness and accuracy.
  • Stay updated on industry trends and emerging technologies to provide strategic technical direction.


Quality Assurance & Risk Management:

  • Implement quality control processes to ensure deliverables meet the required standards.
  • Identify and mitigate project risks, ensuring proactive solutions to potential challenges.


Required Skills & Experience:

  • Fluent English
  • Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a closely related field.
  • Minimum of 8 years of IT Project Management experience in an Agile (Scrum) environment, with a strong focus on application/software development.
  • Prior hands-on development or coding experience.
  • Proven track record of managing teams of Technical Architects, Developers, QA professionals, and Business Analysts.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft DevOps, particularly in managing user stories, epics, sprints, and Agile metrics such as burndown charts.
  • Ability to perform business analysis on projects, including requirements gathering and process documentation.
  • Experience managing project budgets of over $1M and delivering projects on time and within scope.
  • Hands-on experience overseeing all phases of the SDLC, from requirements gathering to deployment.
  • Exceptional communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to convey technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong leadership and team management skills, with a proven ability to motivate and guide cross-functional teams.
  • Strong organization skills and mindset.


Desired Skills & Qualifications:

  • Experience in the Oil and Gas industry is highly desirable.
  • Previous experience in a consulting role or possessing a consultative mindset.
  • PMP certification and CSM.


Other:

  • The role offers a dynamic work environment with opportunities to work on cutting-edge technologies and solutions.
  • The successful candidate will be proactive, detail-oriented, and able to thrive in a fast-paced environment.


Informations:

  • Type of Contract: PJ
  • Hours: Full-time
  • Location: 100% Remote
  • Start Date: Immediate
  • Duration: Long-term

Project Management:

title: SDR Hunter de Influenciadores Gamers
description:
A NoPing é uma plataforma de melhoria de conexão e performance para gamers, focada em reduzir ping, packet loss e aumentar FPS em jogos online.

Estamos montando um time comercial de alta performance para expandir nossa base de influenciadores ao redor do mundo.


Buscamos uma pessoa para atuar como *SDR Hunter*, focada em prospecção, qualificação e primeiro contato com streamers, criadores de conteúdo e parceiros estratégicos.

Se você vive o universo gamer, gosta de falar com pessoas e tem inglês fluente, essa vaga é para você.


*Responsabilidades*


* Prospectar novos influenciadores, afiliados e parceiros em múltiplas plataformas

* Realizar o primeiro contato com creators: e mail, DM em redes sociais, Discord, etc

* Qualificar influenciadores de acordo com critérios definidos pela NoPing

* Explicar de forma clara o que é o NoPing e como o criador pode ganhar dinheiro com a parceria

* Fechar novas parcerias seguindo metas semanais de volume e qualidade

* Garantir o onboarding inicial do influenciador, enviando materiais, scripts e orientações de divulgação

* Registrar todas as interações e status no CRM de forma organizada

* Trabalhar em conjunto com as áreas de Marketing, Parcerias e Sucesso de Influenciadores

* Acompanhar métricas de prospecção, conversão e performance dos influenciadores trazidos

title: Data Analyst
description:
We're looking for a Data Analytics & Engineering Specialist in Brazil!!


Location: Remote (Brazil)

Employment Type: PJ - Open Ended


About the Role

We are looking for a gritty problem solver and self-starter who will serve as a key interface between the Analytics and Engineering teams. In this role, you will deeply understand the needs of analytics stakeholders, anticipate future requirements, and partner closely with Data Engineers to identify, vet, and prioritize upstream data. Your mission is to enable strong analytical capabilities, drive operational excellence, and improve efficiency across data partnerships.


What You’ll Do

  • Rationalize and prioritize data requests, designing ideal and scalable solutions.
  • Execute new data flows and maintain existing pipelines on a daily basis.
  • Design, develop, and maintain robust, efficient data pipelines that support multiple use cases with minimal incremental effort.
  • Drive the vision for Business Intelligence (BI) and Data Warehousing across all business lines, defining and executing a roadmap to achieve that vision.
  • Evolve analytical data ecosystems to support advanced analytics and big data use cases.


Minimum Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in analytics and data engineering.
  • 1+ year of hands-on experience with big data processing systems such as Hadoop, Hive, Spark, or similar technologies.
  • Expert-level proficiency in SQL.
  • Proven ability to design and lead time-sensitive, strategic projects involving methodology development, analysis, and presentation of insights and recommendations.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Degree in a STEM field (Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, or related area).
  • Experience with BI and data visualization tools such as MicroStrategy, Tableau, Looker, or similar platforms.
  • Experience with Unix/Linux shell scripting and Python.
  • Strong database performance tuning and optimization skills.


Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, mathematics, or related field preferred.
